text:
Maya: Heads-up — cut window Tue 3/24 16:00 UTC. Need final canary owners and a short agenda. Can people volunteer? Make sure at least one rollback owner and one smoke test owner.
Jorge: I can own the canary rollout & monitoring. Will prep smoke checklist.
Olivia: I can't make the meeting but can be rollback owner if needed. ping me if we hit errors.
Seema: Can QA be included for the canary validation? I'll ask @zack (QA lead) to join. Also recommend 10m for runbook review.
Samir: +1 for runbook. Also suggest we add an explicit abort threshold (p50/p95 errors, error-rate > 3%) in agenda.
Maya: Cool — draft lite agenda below, plz comment:
```
Lite agenda (30m):
- 5m quick readiness + known risks
- 10m canary plan (owners + target %)
- 5m smoke validation & rollback criteria
- 5m runbook & on-call handoff
- 5m final check & go/no-go
```
Maya: Canary owners so far: Jorge (rollout), Olivia (rollback), Seema (QA). Who's on smoke tests (metrics + logs)?
Jorge: I'll run the smoke script and watch logs. Can someone share the latest smoke test link?
Seema: linking test run: https://ci.internal/smoke/4321 — requires creds, I'll add to shared vault.
Deploy-bot: Scheduled canary slot created for 2026-03-24T16:00Z. Notifying on-call.
Samir: I'm OOO that day until 18:00 UTC but can be on-call post-cut if needed. If we need an additional rollback owner, @nina can cover.
Maya: Thanks. @Nina can you confirm backup rollback coverage?
Nina: I can cover rollback if Olivia is tied up. :thumbsup: 
Maya: Great. Last ask: please RSVP on the calendar event and add any blocking issues to the thread. I'll run a 15m pre-cut sync 30m before the window to sweep last-minute checks.
Olivia: Added notes to calendar, flagged a known infra flake — see ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-3321
Maya: Perfect — closing out. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll finalize the agenda, canary % and post final roster. :rocket:
